about: Labelled retrieval queries for Lantern. Each entry states the exact text the correct passage must contain, so relevance is objective rather than judged from what the system happened to return. `kind` splits the set so a regression can be attributed: lexical (shares words with the answer), morph (a different word form - this is what the stemmer is for), para (paraphrase with little lexical overlap - this is what the dense and HyDE signals are for), distract (a competing answer exists in another document). Entries with kind=multi list every correct passage, so result-set diversity is measured rather than assumed: a set of five near-duplicates scores badly on those even when it scores well on single-answer questions.
